name: Prone Knee Flexion

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity ROM Protocol

steps: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended straight and forehead resting comfortably on your hands.
Keep your pelvis pressed gently into the mat so your lower back does not arch.
Slowly bend your target knee, drawing your heel toward your glute through a full, comfortable range of motion.
Pause for one second at the top of the curl, engaging your hamstring muscles.
Slowly lower your foot back down to the floor under control.
coaching_cues: Keep your hips flat on the mat; do not lift your hip as your knee bends.
Perform smoothly without swinging or kicking.
Focus on a clean, active contraction of the hamstring.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol
